title: 第七章小骷髅的身份第八章小黑的超能力
content_zh:
第七章小骷髅的身份？求推荐，收藏
在这个世界里，人死后灵魂会自动的来到亡灵界当然圣阶和有灵魂神器的除外，来到亡灵界后首先要经历的是位面之间混乱能量的洗礼！来到的灵魂大都会破碎成灵魂碎片。
这些灵魂碎片又会在亡灵界的法则作用下，以主灵魂体的形式与死亡能量和其它的灵魂碎片融合，当融合到一定程度后就会用地面上的尸骨成为亡灵生物。
正是由于灵魂中有了其它的灵魂碎片，让大部分亡灵生物都不会拥有智慧和自己前世的记忆当然陈林是个特例。问为什么？因为他是主角啊。而亡灵生物只有当实力达到六阶初级后，才有机会开启灵智拥有智慧！
这些拥有了智慧的亡灵生物，实力都达到一定的水平，同样也有了智慧！所以它们就会利用自己的实力来威慑，从而驱使一些比自己低级的亡灵。虽然没有陈林的禁魂咒那么变态，也是能建立起自己的势力的！
而像陈林面前的这个小骷髅这样的，本身就是一个很奇怪的现象！没有六阶的实力，却有着不低的智慧，这难免会让陈林产生兴趣……
再又一次仔细打量了一遍小骷髅后，陈林笑呵呵的带着手下向小家伙走去！骷髅怎么笑！汗~看这陈林的表现，小骷髅明显被吓到了！仿佛是即将要被强~暴的少女一样，缩着身子。
看着小骷髅被惊吓的向后退缩的样子，陈林心想“怎么有种一群饥渴难耐的大汉，围着一个可怜的小女生推向小胡同的感觉呢！”陈林看着眼前的情景，不免想起了某个日自己的国度拍摄的大片中的常用情景，是何其的相似……
“不管了，控制住再说”陈林抛开了胡思乱想的念头，就走上前来对着小骷髅，施展起禁魂咒来！
就这样这个‘楚楚可怜’的三阶初级的骷髅战士，被七个最低三阶高级的骷髅战士围了起来，而它的对面更是一个四阶巅峰的比战士还‘强壮’亡灵法师，而且它的眼神让人很不舒服仿佛有着某种**……
可是陈林施展了几次禁魂咒，对方却是出奇的抵抗！“没办法看来只有用强了。”在感觉到小骷髅抗拒的意思的时候，陈林决定要强制的签订契约。
于是陈林释放出自己已经是凡魂阶中级的灵魂之力，在陈林超强的灵魂威压下别说是三阶初级，就是和陈林同一级别的亡灵，也是会畏惧的……
只是这小骷髅的反应，却让陈林很是吃惊！小骷髅好像是没有事一样，虽然依旧很畏惧陈林，但是却依然抗拒着陈林。这让陈林很是惊奇……
要知道自己的灵魂之力，可是修炼的《太平要术》中的神通之一神魂决！灵魂的压制能力很强，曾经在三阶中级的时候，直接威慑住了四阶的亡灵生物！
现在陈林的实力和神魂决都有所提升，但是却对这个三阶初级的小骷髅没办法！
“看来这个小骷髅真是不简单啊，不出绝招不行了”陈林这样想着，于是就运用起神魂决来！在施展起神魂决后，陈林的灵魂威压已经达到了一个恐怖的地步……
就在陈林施展神魂决后，小骷髅表现的越来越吃力！虽然依旧在抗拒着，不过已经有反应了，这让陈林很高兴“只要有反应就好……”于是全力施展起神魂决……
随着时间的推移，小骷髅它的躯体已经到达极限了，眼看骷髅架子就要被压制的破碎了。这让陈林很为难，是继续不是，停下来也不是……
就在陈林还在纠结的时候，突然陈林心头一阵心悸！仿佛世界末日般的危机感笼罩在陈林心头……
紧接着，一道让陈林无法抵抗的灵魂威压扫视了过来！这股灵魂之力仿佛是从千万里远的地方探视过来的！虽然只是一道灵魂之力，不过却让现在的陈林，提不起半点反抗的信心！

要知道《太平要术》是前世的一本奇书，而且陈林神魂决也达到了凡魂阶中级！算是略有小成，但是现在对方一道灵魂之力的探视，就让陈林无法生出反抗的念头！可见对方的强大，绝对超越了圣阶的实力……
“这到底是谁拥有这这么强大的实力，他想干什么……。”陈林很是疑惑，很忐忑这种未知的危机感让人更恐怖！
“咦~……真是个奇特的小家伙！”超强的灵魂威压过来后，先扫视了下陈林！接着就将所有的注意力全部都集中在小骷髅身上！
“这句话是何其的相似，就仿佛自己看见小骷髅一样”陈林听到对方的话后一阵错愕……
但是接着神秘人对陈林没有理睬，只是对着小骷髅说道“唉~，没想到你已经出来了，只是这么大的损失你觉得值得吗？……你怎么就这么心急呢……就这么放弃了……”
就在陈林还很疑惑神秘人对小骷髅说的话的时候，神秘人却将全部的灵魂威压压向陈林！突如其来的灵魂威压，让陈林直接一阵眩晕，陈林赶紧运转起神魂决，这次好受点……
“嗯~！”神秘人轻嗯了一声，“怎么会是完整的灵魂体！……看来也是天意啊……我像你也会是这个意思吧？……”神秘人在那里仿佛是在自言自语，又仿佛是在和小骷髅说……
就在陈林还在糊涂的时候，神秘人接着又说道“好吧，既然如此……我就成全你！”说着神秘人又将灵魂之力，转移到了小骷髅身上……
接着神奇的事情就发生了，本来誓死反抗的小骷髅，竟然自己主动要臣服于陈林！这让陈林无法接受，而且通过刚才神秘人的话，陈林感觉这个小骷髅绝对是和神秘人一个级别的存在……
不过神秘人接下来说了句“希望你以后能善待他……”然后就消失了！在多次确定神秘人走后，陈林这才运用起禁魂咒，收服了小骷髅！
在陈林收服了小骷髅后，陈林脑海中却莫名的出现了小骷髅前世的信息。这种情况还是第一次，以前运用禁魂咒却没有这中情况……，而且陈林明显感觉到自己的灵魂之力，在这次施展禁魂咒的消耗，比以前所有的加起来都多！
这样的情况让陈林很吃惊，心想“这个小骷髅一定不简单……”而且小骷髅并不是他想象中的比较完整灵魂，而只是一缕破损的残魂，他的灵魂仿佛被某种能力封印了。
“真没想到一缕残魂就能拥有智慧，看来我是找了个牛x的小弟啊……”陈林这样想着。
陈林在小骷髅的灵魂中得到的信息，是很多断断续续的画面：
这些画面大都是小骷髅的前世杀戮的场景！他身穿一身墨黑色的铠甲，不断的和敌人战斗！有能开天劈地的人类强者；有力气能撼天动地的泰坦巨人；有实力深不可测的暗黑精灵；还有呼风唤雨的巨龙等等。
小骷髅的前世看起来英武不凡，仿佛是天上的无敌战神！又仿佛是来自地狱嗜血的死神。不轮对手多强结果都是被他杀死。他就像是一个永远也不会失败的神一样……
除此之外，就再没有半点关于他自己的什么的信息了。但让陈林意外的是，在小骷髅前世的记忆中竟然有神秘人的气息和形象。
神秘人的形象在小骷髅心中看起来，并没有小骷髅前世那么夸张，仿佛是个普通人一样，只是他的样貌看不清楚。但是他却在小骷髅心中的地位很高很重要，仿佛是自己的神一样！充满了崇拜和尊敬！
“看来这个世界，并不是我想象中的那么简单啊……”陈林在看完小骷髅的信息后有些感慨，自己以前认为很强大的存在，却被眼前这个小骷髅的前世随意的屠杀！
陈林在自己沉浸了一会后，又激起了斗志“我自己的潜力也不差！《太平要术》中的神通无数，只是神魂决和禁魂咒这两个神通我的成就就不会比你们差……”

陈林在恢复斗志后，才发现小骷髅还在一旁呢！“对了，还没给小家伙起名字呢！你以前世那么强又经常穿着一身黑，就叫你小黑吧！”
“走吧，我带你升升级去~~”陈林带这小黑它们又踏上了征程！

Chapter 7 The identity of the little skeleton? Please recommend and collect
In this world, after death, the soul of a person will automatically come to the world of the undead. Of course, except for those with holy orders and soul artifacts, the first thing they have to experience after coming to the world of the undead is the baptism of chaotic energy between planes! The souls that come will be broken into soul fragments.
These soul fragments will be fused with death energy and other soul fragments in the form of the main soul body under the laws of the undead world. When the fusion reaches a certain level, they will use the bones on the ground to become undead creatures.
It is precisely because of other soul fragments in the soul that most undead creatures do not have wisdom and memories of their previous lives. Of course, Chen Lin is a special case. Ask why? Because he is the protagonist. Only when the strength of undead creatures reaches the sixth level of primary level, can they have the opportunity to activate spiritual intelligence and possess wisdom!
These undead creatures that have wisdom have reached a certain level of strength, and they also have wisdom! Therefore, they will use their own strength to intimidate and drive away some undead that are lower level than themselves. Although it is not as perverted as Chen Lin's soul-forbidden curse, it can still establish its own power!
And something like the little skeleton in front of Chen Lin is a very strange phenomenon in itself! He doesn't have the strength of the sixth level, but he has a lot of wisdom, which will inevitably interest Chen Lin...
After carefully looking at the little skeleton again, Chen Lin led his men towards the little guy with a smile! Why is the skeleton laughing? Sweat~ Looking at Chen Lin’s performance, the little skeleton was obviously frightened! She shrank back like a girl about to be raped.
Seeing the little skeleton shrinking back in fright, Chen Lin thought to himself, "How can it feel like a group of hungry and unbearable men are pushing a poor little girl into a small alley?" Chen Lin looked at the scene in front of him and couldn't help but think of a common scene in a blockbuster filmed in a certain Japanese country. It was so similar...
"No matter, let's get it under control." Chen Lin put aside his random thoughts, walked up to the little skeleton, and cast the soul-forbidden curse!
Just like this, this "poor" third-level junior skeleton warrior was surrounded by seven lowest third-level advanced skeleton warriors, and opposite it was a fourth-level peak necromancer who was "stronger" than a warrior, and its eyes were very uncomfortable, as if it had some kind of lust...
But Chen Lin cast the soul-forbidden curse several times, but the other party was surprisingly resistant! "It seems that I have no choice but to use force." When he felt that the little skeleton was resisting, Chen Lin decided to forcefully sign the contract.
So Chen Lin released the power of his soul, which was already an intermediate mortal soul level. Under Chen Lin's super soul pressure, let alone the third level elementary level, even the undead at the same level as Chen Lin would be afraid...
But the reaction of this little skeleton surprised Chen Lin! The little skeleton seemed to be fine. Although he was still afraid of Chen Lin, he still resisted Chen Lin. This surprised Chen Lin...
You must know the power of your soul, but it is one of the magical powers in the "Taiping Yashu" you practice! The suppressive ability of the soul is very strong. When I was at the intermediate level of the third level, it directly deterred the undead creatures of the fourth level!
Now Chen Lin's strength and soul skills have improved, but there is nothing he can do against this third-level elementary skeleton!
"It seems that this little skeleton is really not easy. It can't be done without a special move." Chen Lin thought, so he used the Soul Art! After using the Divine Soul Art, Chen Lin's soul pressure has reached a terrifying level...
Just after Chen Lin performed the Divine Soul Art, the little skeleton became more and more struggling! Although he was still resisting, there was already a reaction, which made Chen Lin very happy, "As long as there is a reaction..." So he used the Divine Soul Art with all his strength...
As time goes by, the little skeleton's body has reached its limit, and the skeleton frame is about to be destroyed.The oppression was broken. This makes Chen Lin very embarrassed. It's not a matter of continuing or stopping...
Just when Chen Lin was still struggling, Chen Lin suddenly felt palpitations in his heart! A sense of crisis like the end of the world enveloped Chen Lin's heart...
Immediately afterwards, a soul pressure that Chen Lin could not resist glanced over! This soul power seems to be visiting from thousands of miles away! Although it is just a soul power, it makes Chen Lin unable to muster the slightest confidence to resist!
You must know that "The Art of Taiping" is a wonderful book from the previous life, and Chen Lin's Divine Soul Art has also reached the intermediate level of mortal soul! It was a small success, but now that the other party's soul power was visiting him, Chen Lin couldn't even think of resisting! It can be seen that the strength of the other party definitely exceeds the strength of the holy level...
"Who on earth has such a powerful strength? What does he want to do..." Chen Lin was very confused and worried. This sense of unknown crisis makes people even more terrifying!
"Eh~... What a strange little guy!" After the powerful soul pressure came over, he glanced at Chen Lin first! Then focus all your attention on the little skeleton!
"These sentences are so similar, it's like seeing a little skeleton." Chen Lin was stunned after hearing what the other party said...
But then the mysterious man ignored Chen Lin and just said to the little skeleton, "Oh~, I didn't expect you to have come out. But do you think it's worth such a big loss?... Why are you so impatient... Just give up like this..."
Just when Chen Lin was still confused about what the mysterious man said to the little skeleton, the mysterious man pressed all his soul pressure on Chen Lin! The sudden soul pressure made Chen Lin dizzy. Chen Lin quickly activated the Soul Art. This time he felt better...
"Hmm~!" The mysterious man snorted softly, "How can it be a complete soul body!... It seems to be God's will... I think you also mean this, right?..." The mysterious man seemed to be talking to himself, and seemed to be talking to the little skeleton...
Just when Chen Lin was still confused, the mysterious man then said, "Okay, in that case... I will help you!" After saying that, the mysterious man transferred the power of his soul to the little skeleton...
Then something magical happened. The little skeleton who originally vowed to resist to the death actually wanted to surrender to Chen Lin! This was unacceptable to Chen Lin, and through what the mysterious man said just now, Chen Lin felt that this little skeleton was definitely on the same level as the mysterious man...
But the mysterious man then said, "I hope you can treat him well in the future..." and then disappeared! After repeatedly confirming that the mysterious man was gone, Chen Lin used the soul-forbidden spell to subdue the little skeleton!
After Chen Lin subdued Little Skeleton, information about Little Skull's previous life appeared in Chen Lin's mind. This is the first time this has happened. There has been no such situation when using the Soul Confinement Curse before... Moreover, Chen Lin clearly felt that the power of his soul, the consumption of casting the Soul Confinement Curse this time was more than all the previous ones combined!
This situation surprised Chen Lin, thinking, "This little skeleton must not be simple..." Moreover, the little skeleton was not a relatively complete soul as he imagined, but just a damaged remnant soul. His soul seemed to be sealed by some kind of ability.
"I never thought that a remnant soul could possess wisdom. It seems that I have found an awesome younger brother..." Chen Lin thought like this.
The information Chen Lin got from the soul of the little skeleton was a lot of intermittent scenes:
Most of these scenes are scenes of killings in Little Skull’s previous life! He wore a jet black armor and kept fighting the enemy! There are strong human beings who can split the sky and split the earth; Titans who are powerful enough to shake the heavens and earth; dark elves with unfathomable strength; and giant dragons who can control the wind and rain, etc.
The little skeleton looked heroic in his previous life, as if he was the invincible god of war in the sky! It seems likeThe bloodthirsty god of death from hell. No matter how strong the opponent is, he will always end up killing him. He is like a god who will never fail...
Other than that, there is no other information about himself. But what surprised Chen Lin was that there was the aura and image of a mysterious person in the memory of the little skeleton's previous life.
The image of the mysterious man in Little Skull's mind was not as exaggerated as Little Skull's previous life. He seemed to be an ordinary person, but his appearance could not be clearly seen. But he has a very high and important status in the little skull's heart, as if he is his own god! Full of adoration and respect!
"It seems that this world is not as simple as I imagined..." Chen Lin felt a little emotional after reading the information about the little skeleton. The existence that he thought was very powerful in the past was casually massacred by the previous life of the little skeleton in front of him!
After Chen Lin immersed himself in it for a while, he aroused his fighting spirit again, "My own potential is not bad! There are countless magical powers in "Taiping Yashu", but for the two magical powers of Divine Soul Art and Soul Forbidden Curse, my achievements are no worse than yours..."
After Chen Lin regained his fighting spirit, he realized that the little skeleton was still there! "By the way, I haven't given the little guy a name yet! You were so strong in your previous life and often wore black, so let's call you Xiao Hei!"
"Let's go, I'll take you to upgrade~~" Chen Lin took Xiao Hei and the others on their journey again!
